text: And stay until the end... because the last one didn't happen on a pitch at all.
January twenty ten. Real Madrid against Malaga. Ronaldo has already scored twice.
Then Patrick Mtiliga grabs him. Ronaldo swings his arm back to break free... and catches him right in the face.
Mtiliga's nose is broken. Straight red. Ronaldo went to Malaga's dressing room to apologise, and still got a two-match ban.
Five years later, it happened again.
That was on the pitch. The next one happened on a quiet walk by a lake.
A few days earlier, he had missed a penalty against Austria. The pressure was enormous.
That same night, against Hungary, he scored twice.
A microphone is one thing. Two years later... came the tears.
It was the first red card of his Champions League career. In his one hundred and fifty-fourth game.
A red card hurts him. But you know what hurts him more? A goal that doesn't count.
We're halfway. Keep a number in your head for the worst one so far... because the next one got the police involved.
The fan was a fourteen-year-old boy. His mum said his hand was bruised.
And that was only April. By October, he had fallen out with his own manager.
Weeks later, in a TV interview with Piers Morgan, he said he felt betrayed... and that he had no respect for ten Hag.
But some of his angriest moments came in a Portugal shirt.
A lot of players hate it when a referee does that. But he's the captain... and every camera in the stadium was on him.
A year later, the cameras caught something much worse.
Almost there. And the last one... is the strangest of all.
